purpose: Opens set-up's app as Finder would, with Claude Code under both measured profiles, to check that once its session server is live set-up opens the address where the owner's first message starts the session, says what to do there, waits for that message with its window up, pauses naming the server's last line when the server is never live, and finishes on the session's record.
title: The first conversation on the day's Claude Code

testCases.description: set-up under 2.1.332 opens its server's own environment address, says what to do there and finishes on the session
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/first-conversation-on-connect.test.js::set-up under Claude Code 2.1.332 opens, once its session server is live, the address of that server's own environment, never plain claude.ai/code, says to send a first message there and that Claude may ask to sign in again, and finishes on the session record the first message makes

testCases.description: set-up under 2.1.319 still finishes its first conversation
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/first-conversation-on-connect.test.js::set-up under Claude Code 2.1.319, whose server makes its session at start, still finishes its first conversation and opens Claude's page

testCases.description: a session server never live within 2 minutes pauses set-up naming its last line
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/first-conversation-on-connect.test.js::set-up whose session server is never live within 2 minutes of its start pauses, and the paused window names the server's own last line

testCases.description: set-up waiting for the owner's first message keeps its window up and does not pause at 2 minutes
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/first-conversation-on-connect.test.js::while set-up waits for the owner's first message in the page it opened, it keeps its window up naming that page, and does not pause at 2 minutes or 2 and a half

testCases.description: at the end of the wait for a first message the paused window names the page
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/first-conversation-on-connect.test.js::when the owner sends no first message within set-up's wait, shortened here by a test setting, a Squire window is up for the whole wait and the paused window takes its place at the bound, naming the page set-up opened

testCases.description: the waiting window says set-up waits 30 minutes for the first message
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/first-conversation-on-connect.test.js::with no test setting, the window up while set-up waits for the owner's first message says how long it waits: 30 minutes
